title: LLM智能体系统中技能的规模定律
summary: 该研究揭示了智能体系统中技能库规模的两个耦合定律：路由定律（单步路由准确率随库大小对数衰减）和执行定律（正确执行可改善下游决策约4倍）。通过15个前沿LLM、1141个真实技能和超过300万次路由/执行决策验证。基于定律的优化将路由准确率从71.3%提升至91.7%，劫持率从22.4%降至4.1%，并在下游基准测试中显著提升通过率。
summary_en: This paper identifies two coupled scaling laws in LLM agent systems: routing law (logarithmic decay of accuracy with library size) and execution law (correct execution improves downstream decisions ~4x). Validated across 15 LLMs, 1,141 skills, and 3M+ decisions. Law-guided optimization boosts routing accuracy from 71.3% to 91.7%, reduces hijack from 22.4% to 4.1%, and improves downstream pass rates.
